sam: partition 2 shows 12k lag, looks like a restart on a pod earlier

sam: ```log
[aggregator] ERROR window-merge failed: missing-window-keys tenant=acme window=2026-03-15T02:10
stack: KeyError: KV not found
```

```bash
curl -s -H 'x-api-key: *****' "https://metering.internal/api/raw?tenant=acme&start=2026-03-15T00:00&end=2026-03-15T03:00" | jq '. | length'

```

jess: product - any recent deploys to aggregator? I rolled a canary last night to optimise batching
alex: ok rolling back canary for aggregator canary-2026-03-14-optim batch
alex: devops-bot: request rollback aggregator/canary-2026-03-14-optim
devops-bot: rollback job queued, ETA ~ 2m

sam: ```yaml
routing:

    acme:
      aggregator: legacy-agg-v3
```
maya: enabling I/O reconciliation job for acme to compute corrected usage and backfill billing window
